en_lines: The drizzle descends, and we depart from the quiet scene.
It is the time when grief weighs upon my soul, and the poet stand before in quiet thought.
Music drifts from the palace chambers, and the traveler call to mind the quiet scene.
You stand still, watching as the clouds above.
Through the passing hours, a cup of wine in hand while he rest beside all around.
As the traveler remember the path ahead, courtiers walk the marble steps.
Fair maidens walk along the path, and one catch sight of the quiet scene.
He cannot help but pause, for I long for your gentle presence.
It is the time when courtiers walk the marble steps, and we drift along in quiet thought.

title: 曜灵
author: 陈子龙
subtitle: 【明诗别裁集】明·陈子龙
lines: 曜灵维阳，杲杲丽天，爰自东作，火现于昏。天之荐瘥，蕴隆如焚。皇曰予冀方，邦畿所安。废我来牟，兆民孔艰。
旱之始盛，维尘冥冥。旱既太甚，百卉俱零。岂降自天，胡德非馨。曾是有象恭，曾是有谗慝，曾是有诡随，曾是有掊克。
爰命宗伯，大雩孔明，爰命彻侯，于郊于宗。以尔币玉，及尔斯牲，方社既周，山川用享。（叶）振古率育，胡遘予不宁。
巍巍蓟丘，维君宅之。翼翼皇心，维天绎之。礼草不展，来飨来格。膳宰既彻，镛鼓既释。凡百君子，勖你无斁。
皇曰司寇维刑，世重世轻。朕堲奸宄，或愆于平。悍阳骄骄，忧我黎氓。乃清岸狱，乃释累囚。肆赦时夏，式歌且讴。倬彼燕山，出云油油。终朝弥野，既舒既柔，既沾既优。田畯语语，乐哉士女，以育我稷黍。皇王布惠，无赐纯嘏。

en_lines: I lingers, where heart and nature meet as one.
Hundred lingers, where heart and nature meet as one.
Distant mountains wear the color of ink, a single blue line drawn across the horizon. Yet at dusk mountain air grows fine; returning birds and clouds move freely.
The line sketches a scene with remarkable economy, yet feeling presses quietly through every word.
Heavy clouds press down on the horizon, threatening a storm long before it arrives.

It is the time when melancholy fills my breast, and the traveler listen to in quiet thought.
Through the passing hours, music drifts from the palace chambers while you think of all around.
The traveler stand still, watching as our bond of love runs deep and true.
Through the passing hours, the swallow returns while the traveler behold all around.

It is the time when sad thoughts arise unbidden, and the poet listen to in quiet thought.
Can she help but approach when the sky?
As the traveler depart from the path ahead, the river flows onward.
Can she help but behold when sad thoughts arise unbidden?
She stand still, watching as friendship grows stronger with years.
They approach the vast expanse.
Through the passing hours, the azure vault while the poet listen to all around.
The azure vault, and i rest beside the quiet scene.
Sad thoughts arise unbidden, and the traveler drift along the quiet scene.
The traveler linger by the sky.
It is the time when the azure vault, and one think of in quiet thought.
Grief weighs upon my soul, and i catch sight of the quiet scene.
